release_note: BSP and local firmware releases differ. Addresses/topology were cross-checked against the captured live Android DT; no ABI or runtime compatibility is implied.

mapping_notes: Sizes of zero-length DT macro/SWR/LPI nodes come from pinned driver ioremap arguments, not inferred page sizes.
SWR size 0x60a8 is the literal vendor ioremap length. The register at offset 0x60a8 is outside it; page padding does not enlarge accessible bounds.
Reserved ADSP ranges are firmware-owned RAM, not XNU allocations. IOVA ranges and SID masks describe Android, not an installed XNU DMA domain.
SoundWire device addresses and I2C slave addresses are separate from AP MMIO. Android enabled status does not prove device probe, ownership or audio operation.

transport.interrupt_note: ADSP wdog is PDC6 translated using DT PDC range to GIC SPI486; remaining ADSP notifications are SMP2P bits, not GIC INTIDs.

driver_mapping_lengths.name: SWR master
driver_mapping_lengths.note: Exact length passed to devm_ioremap in vendor source, not an independently measured MMIO aperture or permission to access. Preserve raw DT size 0 separately. Last 32-bit register named by this macro would extend four bytes beyond literal length; do not round up silently.

gpr.note: Service IDs, DSP module instance IDs, codec stream IDs, and SoundWire port type IDs are separate number spaces.

wcd939x.note: WCD939x SoundWire codec is distinct from qcom,wcd939x-i2c USB-C switch at I2C address 0x0e.

sia9177.note: Driver has multiple other amplifier families; only CHIP_TYPE_SIA9177 ID ranges are included. Init/startup/shutdown/SRAM sequences are firmware data driven, not inferred from generic defaults.

firmware.note: MDT includes signed metadata/hash data. Verify 2 MDTs and 54 nonzero PT_LOAD files; b24/b55 are zero-filled RAM. No loader, authentication, memory assignment, DSP start or calibration is implemented.
